description: This file defines classes and interfaces for safe, reference-counted access to file descriptors, including the SharedFD class, FileInstance class, and related utilities. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and provides abstractions for managing file descriptors in a resource-safe manner, including support for Linux-specific features like epoll, eventfd, and vsock. The file also includes licensing information and includes various system headers.

classes.name: SharedFD
classes.description: A reference-counted, safe wrapper around a file descriptor, providing methods for creating, duplicating, and managing file descriptors, with comparison operators and access to the underlying FileInstance.

classes.name: WeakFD
classes.description: A non-owning weak reference to a SharedFD, which can be locked to obtain a SharedFD if the underlying resource still exists.

classes.name: ScopedMMap
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for memory-mapped regions, ensuring proper cleanup.

classes.name: FileInstance
classes.description: Represents an open file descriptor with methods for I/O operations, resource management, and system call wrappers. It manages the lifetime of the underlying file descriptor.

methods.name: SharedFD()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to a closed file descriptor.
